title: 摩根资管ETF主管：中国主动ETF启航，首募超20亿意味着什么？
speaker: Travis Spence

segments.en: I think first of all, this is big news. We're really excited about this.
segments.zh: 首先，这是重大消息，我们非常兴奋。

segments.en: If you look at what's happening in the overall ETF industry and Eric alluded to it, it's great to be here in the same market as Eric and on TV with them, but active has really been
segments.zh: 纵观整个ETF行业，Eric也提到了，很高兴能与Eric同台，但主动管理确实一直在

segments.en: driving the growth rate of the global ETF market and it's not just in the U.S. out here in the region, Korea, Australia, and even more recently Taiwan, have seen big increase in
segments.zh: 推动全球ETF市场的增长，不仅在美国，在亚洲地区，韩国、澳大利亚，以及最近的台湾，都出现了大幅增长

segments.en: the active ETF space. So we actually think that this is the next leg up in the second largest ETF market which is China.
segments.zh: 主动ETF领域。因此我们认为，这是中国这个第二大ETF市场的下一步发展。

segments.en: I was just up in China last week and one thing that was really clear is investors want active management.
segments.zh: 我上周刚去过中国，很明显的一点是，市场参与者想要主动管理。

segments.en: You've got a two-speed economy. You've got a huge amount of volatility that's happened in the market this year.
segments.zh: 经济呈现双速增长，今年市场出现了巨大波动。

segments.en: So that is very clear. And now they can do that with the advantages and the efficiency of the ETF vehicle as well.
segments.zh: 这一点非常清楚。现在他们也可以利用ETF工具的优势和效率来实现。

segments.en: So I think this is big news. We were excited that the first ETF that we launched and we're the only wholly owned foreign manager in this first round of 18, but we reached our quote, actually we're over
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是重大消息。我们很兴奋，我们推出的第一只ETF，而且我们是首轮18家中唯一的外商独资管理人，但我们达到了配额，实际上我们超额

segments.en: subscribed, over the two billion mark, R&B on Friday.
segments.zh: 认购，周五超过了20亿大关。

segments.en: So we're one of three that hit that mark and we're not stopping there.
segments.zh: 所以我们是达到这一门槛的三家之一，而且我们不会止步于此。

segments.en: We're actually going to be adding 75 million U.S. equivalents so call it half a billion R&B of seed capital after the launch just to continue to support the development and growth
segments.zh: 我们实际上将追加7500万美元等值，也就是约5亿人民币的种子资本，在产品推出后继续支持发展和增长

segments.en: of the active ETF industry in China.
segments.zh: 中国主动型ETF行业的发展。
